"""Source-bound, unselected grade-crest three-point-turn requests."""
import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
CASE = HERE.parents[1]
ROOT = CASE.parents[1]
SOURCE = HERE / "assignment-source.json" if (HERE / "assignment-source.json").is_file() else ROOT / "inputs" / CASE.name / "assignment.json"
PLAN = HERE / "case-plan.json" if (HERE / "case-plan.json").is_file() else CASE / "case-plan.json"
SOURCE_SHA = "d1490ce9bff6b98b001e5e12eb8498bfb028d66a236c814f81cb9e8e222b0285"
RATE = 20
FRAMES = 700
CASES = {"probe_01": 0.8, "probe_02": 12.0}
POLICIES = {
    "primary": (5.0, "standard", False),
    "fallback1": (3.0, "standard", False),
    "fallback2": (5.0, "elevated_overview", False),
    "fallback3": (5.0, "standard", True),
}


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def put(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, indent=2, allow_nan=False) + "\n")


def elevation(x, height):
    return height * (1 - ((x - 200) / 200) ** 2)


def road(height):
    slope = height / 100
    quadratic = -height / 40000
    return f'''<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<OpenDRIVE><header revMajor="1" revMinor="4" name="C104496 authored grade crest" version="1.00" date="2026-11-08" north="8" south="-8" east="450" west="0" vendor="worker"/>
<road name="two-way graded highway" length="450" id="407" junction="-1">
<type s="0" type="rural"><speed max="25" unit="mph"/></type>
<planView><geometry s="0" x="0" y="0" hdg="0" length="450"><line/></geometry></planView>
<elevationProfile><elevation s="0" a="0" b="{slope:.9f}" c="{quadratic:.9f}" d="0"/></elevationProfile>
<lanes><laneSection s="0"><left><lane id="1" type="driving" level="false"><width sOffset="0" a="4.5" b="0" c="0" d="0"/><roadMark sOffset="0" type="solid" color="white" width="0.12"/></lane></left><center><lane id="0" type="none" level="false"><roadMark sOffset="0" type="solid" color="yellow" width="0.15"/></lane></center><right><lane id="-1" type="driving" level="false"><width sOffset="0" a="4.5" b="0" c="0" d="0"/><roadMark sOffset="0" type="solid" color="white" width="0.12"/></lane></right></laneSection></lanes><objects/><signals/></road></OpenDRIVE>
'''


def turn_pose(distance):
    """Requested swept centerline: forward left, reverse right, forward left."""
    p0 = (200 + 8 * math.sin(1.2), -1.75 + 8 * (1 - math.cos(1.2)))
    p1 = (p0[0] - 8 * (math.sin(2.0) - math.sin(1.2)),
          p0[1] + 8 * (math.cos(2.0) - math.cos(1.2)))
    if distance <= 20:
        return 180 + distance, -1.75, 0.0, "approach"
    distance -= 20
    if distance <= 9.6:
        theta = distance / 8
        return 200 + 8 * math.sin(theta), -1.75 + 8 * (1 - math.cos(theta)), theta, "forward_left"
    distance -= 9.6
    if distance <= 6.4:
        theta = 1.2 + distance / 8
        return (p0[0] - 8 * (math.sin(theta) - math.sin(1.2)),
                p0[1] + 8 * (math.cos(theta) - math.cos(1.2)), theta, "reverse_right")
    distance -= 6.4
    if distance <= 8 * (math.pi - 2):
        theta = 2 + distance / 8
        return (p1[0] + 8 * (math.sin(theta) - math.sin(2)),
                p1[1] + 8 * (math.cos(2) - math.cos(theta)), theta, "forward_left_finish")
    distance -= 8 * (math.pi - 2)
    endpoint_x = p1[0] - 8 * math.sin(2)
    endpoint_y = p1[1] + 8 * (math.cos(2) + 1)
    return endpoint_x - distance, endpoint_y, math.pi, "opposite_direction"


def rows(suffix, candidate):
    speed, _, stop = POLICIES[candidate]
    height = CASES[suffix]
    out = []
    for frame in range(FRAMES):
        t = frame / RATE
        distance = min(speed * t, 19.0) if stop else speed * t
        x, y, heading, phase = turn_pose(distance)
        other_x = min(180.0, 47.6 + 4.0 * t)
        out.append({"frame": frame, "time_s": t, "requested_ego_xyz_m": [round(x, 6), round(y, 6), round(elevation(x, height), 6)],
                    "requested_heading_rad": round(heading, 6), "requested_speed_mps": 0 if stop and speed*t >= 19 else speed,
                    "requested_motion_phase": "stop_before_crest" if stop and speed*t >= 19 else phase,
                    "requested_other_vehicle_xyz_m": [round(other_x, 6), 1.75, round(elevation(other_x, height), 6)],
                    "requested_other_vehicle_approach": "west", "other_approach_virtual_camera_x_m": 352.4,
                    "original_body_rays_observed": False, "human_visibility_reviewed": False, "legal_verdict": None})
    return out


def build():
    if sha(SOURCE) != SOURCE_SHA:
        raise ValueError("Frozen assignment changed")
    source = json.loads(SOURCE.read_text())
    plan = json.loads(PLAN.read_text())
    law = source["law_record"]["text"]
    if (plan["source_law_text"] != law or source["actor"] != "motor_vehicle_driver" or
            {k: source["cell"][k] for k in ("layout", "maneuver", "control")} !=
            {"layout": "hill_crest", "maneuver": "u_turn", "control": "other_vehicle"}):
        raise ValueError("Frozen law, actor or cell changed")
    entries = []
    for suffix, height in CASES.items():
        road_text = road(height)
        for candidate, (speed, camera, stop) in POLICIES.items():
            bundle = HERE / "drafts" / suffix / candidate
            bundle.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            (bundle / "assignment-source.json").write_bytes(SOURCE.read_bytes())
            (bundle / "case-plan.json").write_bytes(PLAN.read_bytes())
            (bundle / "crest.xodr").write_text(road_text)
            tracks = bundle / "requested-tracks.jsonl"
            tracks.write_text("".join(json.dumps(row, sort_keys=True) + "\n" for row in rows(suffix, candidate)))
            cfg = {"format": "c104496-crest-request-v1", "assignment_id": CASE.name,
                   "case_id": CASE.name + "__" + suffix, "candidate_id": candidate,
                   "assignment_sha256": SOURCE_SHA, "case_plan_sha256": sha(PLAN),
                   "road_sha256": sha(bundle / "crest.xodr"), "tracks_sha256": sha(tracks),
                   "source_text": law, "rate_hz": RATE, "frames": FRAMES,
                   "crest_station_m": 200, "grade_height_m": height,
                   "requested_speed_mps": speed, "camera_policy": camera,
                   "stop_before_crest": stop, "other_vehicle_blueprint": "vehicle.audi.a2",
                   "ego_blueprint": "vehicle.tesla.model3", "status": "unselected_native_request",
                   "original_native_observed": False, "legal_verdict": None}
            put(bundle / "config.json", cfg)
            entries.append({"case_id": cfg["case_id"], "candidate_id": candidate,
                            "config_sha256": sha(bundle / "config.json"), "tracks_sha256": sha(tracks)})
    manifest = {"format": "c104496-crest-construction-v1", "assignment_id": CASE.name,
                "assignment_sha256": SOURCE_SHA, "case_plan_sha256": sha(PLAN),
                "status": "draft_not_selected", "entries": entries, "delivery_ready": False}
    put(HERE / "manifest.json", manifest)
    return manifest


if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(json.dumps({"requests": len(build()["entries"])}))

"""Independent exact offline check of copied source, grade and swept requests."""
import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from build import CASES, FRAMES, PLAN, POLICIES, RATE, SOURCE, SOURCE_SHA, elevation, road, rows


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def check(bundle):
    bundle = Path(bundle)
    cfg = json.loads((bundle / "config.json").read_text())
    suffix = cfg["case_id"].split("__")[-1]
    candidate = cfg["candidate_id"]
    if suffix not in CASES or candidate not in POLICIES:
        raise ValueError("Unknown case or candidate")
    if (sha(SOURCE) != SOURCE_SHA or (bundle / "assignment-source.json").read_bytes() != SOURCE.read_bytes() or
            (bundle / "case-plan.json").read_bytes() != PLAN.read_bytes()):
        raise ValueError("Copied frozen source or plan changed")
    source = json.loads(SOURCE.read_text())
    plan = json.loads(PLAN.read_text())
    law = source["law_record"]["text"]
    speed, camera, stop = POLICIES[candidate]
    if (cfg["format"] != "c104496-crest-request-v1" or
            cfg["assignment_id"] != source["assignment_id"] or
            cfg["case_id"] != source["assignment_id"] + "__" + suffix or
            cfg["source_text"] != law or plan["source_law_text"] != law or
            cfg["assignment_sha256"] != SOURCE_SHA or cfg["case_plan_sha256"] != sha(PLAN) or
            cfg["road_sha256"] != sha(bundle / "crest.xodr") or
            cfg["tracks_sha256"] != sha(bundle / "requested-tracks.jsonl") or
            cfg["rate_hz"] != RATE or cfg["frames"] != FRAMES or
            cfg["crest_station_m"] != 200 or cfg["grade_height_m"] != CASES[suffix] or
            cfg["requested_speed_mps"] != speed or cfg["camera_policy"] != camera or
            cfg["stop_before_crest"] is not stop or
            cfg["status"] != "unselected_native_request" or
            cfg["original_native_observed"] is not False or cfg["legal_verdict"] is not None):
        raise ValueError("Source join, policy, or evidence status changed")
    if (bundle / "crest.xodr").read_text() != road(CASES[suffix]):
        raise ValueError("Authored road bytes changed")
    root = ET.parse(bundle / "crest.xodr").getroot()
    geom = root.find("./road/planView/geometry")
    ep = root.find("./road/elevationProfile/elevation")
    lanes = root.findall("./road/lanes/laneSection/*/lane")
    if (geom is None or geom.get("length") != "450" or geom.find("line") is None or
            ep is None or len(lanes) != 3 or
            {(x.get("id"), x.get("type")) for x in lanes} !=
            {("1", "driving"), ("0", "none"), ("-1", "driving")} or
            abs(float(ep.get("b")) - CASES[suffix] / 100) > 1e-8 or
            abs(float(ep.get("c")) + CASES[suffix] / 40000) > 1e-8):
        raise ValueError("Crest or lane geometry changed")
    actual = [json.loads(x) for x in (bundle / "requested-tracks.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
    if actual != rows(suffix, candidate):
        raise ValueError("Requested 700-frame swept path changed")
    phases = {r["requested_motion_phase"] for r in actual}
    if stop:
        if "stop_before_crest" not in phases or "reverse_right" in phases:
            raise ValueError("Stop fallback changed")
    elif not {"forward_left", "reverse_right", "forward_left_finish", "opposite_direction"} <= phases:
        raise ValueError("Three-point reverse path absent")
    for r in actual:
        x, y, z = r["requested_ego_xyz_m"]
        ox, oy, oz = r["requested_other_vehicle_xyz_m"]
        if not (0 <= x <= 450 and -4.5 <= y <= 4.5 and
                abs(z - elevation(x, CASES[suffix])) < 2e-6 and
                oy == 1.75 and abs(oz - elevation(ox, CASES[suffix])) < 2e-6):
            raise ValueError("Swept path outside authored road or grade")
    if actual[100]["requested_other_vehicle_xyz_m"][0] <= actual[0]["requested_other_vehicle_xyz_m"][0]:
        raise ValueError("Other vehicle is not approaching")
    return {"case_id": cfg["case_id"], "candidate": candidate,
            "requested_phases": sorted(phases), "original_visibility_verified": False,
            "delivery_ready": False}

"""Process synthetic analytic sightlines; original Native observations remain separate."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
from build import CASES, HERE, POLICIES, elevation, put, sha
from check import check

DISTANCE_M = 152.4
EYE_HEIGHT_M = 1.4
BODY_SAMPLE_HEIGHT_M = 1.4


def ray_margin(subject_x, observer_x, grade_height):
    """Max road height above eye-to-body segment, sampled at 101 points."""
    start = elevation(observer_x, grade_height) + EYE_HEIGHT_M
    end = elevation(subject_x, grade_height) + BODY_SAMPLE_HEIGHT_M
    return max(elevation(observer_x + (subject_x - observer_x) * i / 100, grade_height) -
               (start + (end - start) * i / 100) for i in range(101))


def process(bundle, raw_path):
    bundle, raw_path = Path(bundle), Path(raw_path)
    checked = check(bundle)
    cfg = json.loads((bundle / "config.json").read_text())
    raw = json.loads(raw_path.read_text())
    suffix, candidate = cfg["case_id"].split("__")[-1], cfg["candidate_id"]
    if (raw.get("format") != "c104496-synthetic-ray-raw-v1" or
            raw.get("synthetic") is not True or raw.get("config_sha256") != sha(bundle / "config.json") or
            raw.get("tracks_sha256") != sha(bundle / "requested-tracks.jsonl") or
            raw.get("case_id") != cfg["case_id"] or raw.get("candidate_id") != candidate or
            raw.get("original_native_observed") is not False or raw.get("human_visibility_reviewed") is not False):
        raise ValueError("Raw source, status or synthetic provenance changed")
    requests = [json.loads(x) for x in (bundle / "requested-tracks.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
    if len(raw.get("rows", [])) != len(requests):
        raise ValueError("Raw/request frame count changed")
    measured = []
    for row, request in zip(raw["rows"], requests):
        if row.get("frame") != request["frame"] or row.get("requested_ego_xyz_m") != request["requested_ego_xyz_m"]:
            raise ValueError("Raw/request frame or pose join changed")
        x = request["requested_ego_xyz_m"][0]
        expected = [round(ray_margin(x, x - DISTANCE_M, CASES[suffix]), 6),
                    round(ray_margin(x, x + DISTANCE_M, CASES[suffix]), 6)]
        if row.get("analytic_road_above_ray_m") != expected:
            raise ValueError("Synthetic line-of-sight measurement changed")
        measured.append({"frame": request["frame"], "phase": request["requested_motion_phase"],
                         "synthetic_road_above_ray_m": expected})
    turn = [r for r in measured if r["phase"] in ("forward_left", "reverse_right", "forward_left_finish")]
    clear = sum(all(m <= 0 for m in r["synthetic_road_above_ray_m"]) for r in turn)
    blocked = len(turn) - clear
    return {"format": "c104496-synthetic-saved-v1", "case_id": checked["case_id"],
            "candidate_id": candidate, "raw_sha256": sha(raw_path), "config_sha256": sha(bundle / "config.json"),
            "frames_joined": len(measured), "turn_frames": len(turn),
            "analytic_both_clear_turn_frames": clear, "analytic_road_above_ray_turn_frames": blocked,
            "minimum_clear_fraction": round(clear / len(turn), 6) if turn else None,
            "trigger_slow_if_clear_fraction_below": 0.95,
            "trigger_overview_if_original_pixel_review_missing": True,
            "trigger_stop_if_original_500ft_body_rays_missing": True,
            "synthetic": True, "original_native_observed": False,
            "human_visibility_reviewed": False, "legal_verdict": None,
            "delivery_ready": False}


def make_raw(bundle):
    bundle = Path(bundle)
    cfg = json.loads((bundle / "config.json").read_text())
    suffix = cfg["case_id"].split("__")[-1]
    requests = [json.loads(x) for x in (bundle / "requested-tracks.jsonl").read_text().splitlines()]
    out = []
    for r in requests:
        x = r["requested_ego_xyz_m"][0]
        out.append({"frame": r["frame"], "requested_ego_xyz_m": r["requested_ego_xyz_m"],
                    "analytic_road_above_ray_m": [round(ray_margin(x, x - DISTANCE_M, CASES[suffix]), 6),
                                                  round(ray_margin(x, x + DISTANCE_M, CASES[suffix]), 6)]})
    return {"format": "c104496-synthetic-ray-raw-v1", "case_id": cfg["case_id"],
            "candidate_id": cfg["candidate_id"], "config_sha256": sha(bundle / "config.json"),
            "tracks_sha256": sha(bundle / "requested-tracks.jsonl"), "rows": out,
            "synthetic": True, "original_native_observed": False, "human_visibility_reviewed": False}


def build_saved():
    outputs = []
    for suffix in CASES:
        for candidate in POLICIES:
            bundle = HERE / "drafts" / suffix / candidate
            raw_path = HERE / "synthetic" / suffix / candidate / "raw.json"
            saved_path = raw_path.parent / "saved.json"
            put(raw_path, make_raw(bundle))
            put(saved_path, process(bundle, raw_path))
            outputs.append({"case_id": suffix, "candidate": candidate,
                            "raw_sha256": sha(raw_path), "saved_sha256": sha(saved_path)})
    put(HERE / "saved-manifest.json", {"format": "c104496-synthetic-saved-manifest-v1",
                                      "entries": outputs, "original_native_observed": False})
    return outputs


if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(json.dumps({"processed": len(build_saved())}))

import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from check import check
from saved import make_raw, process

class CrestExact(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_copied_source_and_status(self):
        row = check(Path.cwd())
        self.assertFalse(row["delivery_ready"])
        self.assertFalse(row["original_visibility_verified"])
    def test_swept_path(self):
        row = check(Path.cwd())
        if row["candidate"] == "fallback3":
            self.assertIn("stop_before_crest", row["requested_phases"])
        else:
            self.assertIn("reverse_right", row["requested_phases"])
    def test_synthetic_saved(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            raw_path = Path(tmp) / "raw.json"
            put(raw_path, make_raw(Path.cwd()))
            row = process(Path.cwd(), raw_path)
            self.assertEqual(row["frames_joined"], 700)
            self.assertFalse(row["delivery_ready"])
